name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with the intricate mechanics of his grandfather's vintage Citroen. After earning a degree in engineering, he initially worked in the aerospace industry, developing a meticulous eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to precision. However, the roar of the racetrack proved too alluring, and he transitioned to motorsport, bringing his rigorous standards to bear on quality control.

At Allied Racing, Jean-Pierre is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can have catastrophic consequences on the track, and he approaches every inspection with an almost obsessive focus. His exacting standards can be demanding, but his colleagues respect his expertise and recognize his unwavering dedication to ensuring the team's success. He prides himself on catching errors before they become problems, saving valuable time and resources.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a man of average height with a serious demeanor.

Insists on using a specific brand of French coffee in the workshop.
